input.objective:
Token name: Pupate
Token symbol: PUPATE

Total supply 1,000,000,000 with 18 decimals, minted once to its deployer. Ethereum mainnet (chain id 1), a Uniswap v4 hook launch paired with native ETH; 85% of supply to the pool.

LAUNCH THIS REPOSITORY AS IT IS. The workspace is a finished, tested and reviewed project at the given base commit. The deliverable is the launch of this exact code: do not rewrite, refactor or reformat it, and do not modify src/, test/, script/, lib/ or foundry.toml. PupateHook is bound by its constructor to two contracts already deployed on Ethereum mainnet from this source: the vault Cocoon at 0xc4e514e60565a2c04bd657f18bb34b503d6c299d (its sink) and an OpenZeppelin TimelockController with a 48-hour delay at 0x8be826082c0fbaec485048aa26ef42ac147898ec (its owner).

WHAT TO DO. (1) Verify that launch.json is a valid manifest: hook PupateHook with constructor ($poolManager, the Cocoon address, the timelock address); permissions afterInitialize, beforeAddLiquidity, beforeSwap, afterSwap, beforeSwapReturnDelta, afterSwapReturnDelta (flags 0x18CC, validated by the constructor against the hook's own address, so it needs a mined CREATE2 salt); token PupateToken with a zero-argument constructor; pool fee 12500, tick spacing 60, native ETH. Keep pool.initialPrice as it is (792281625142643375935439503360000, the policy's 10 ETH valuation, tick 184216): it is not a reference value to replace. (2) Run the existing suite (forge test; test/fork runs only with MAINNET_RPC_URL set) and report the result. (3) Review the code as it is; report a defect with a reproducing test instead of changing the source.

KEEP THESE FACTS UNCHANGED. PupateToken is a plain ERC-20: no owner, mint, pause, fee, transfer limit or blacklist; burn and burnFrom only reduce supply. PupateHook taxes the ETH side of every swap in its launch pool, the first native-ETH pool initialised on it; swaps whose sender is the sink are not taxed. Sells pay the standing tax of 6%. Buys pay 99% when the pool opens, falling one percentage point a minute to the standing tax about 93 minutes later. The tax is collected inside the swap as ERC-6909 claims on the PoolManager; swap callbacks call only the PoolManager and move no ETH. A taxed swap that names its ETH amount and cannot fill in full reverts (PartialFill). flush() is permissionless and hands the hook's whole ETH balance to Cocoon.depositTax. The owner can only lower the standing tax and transfer ownership.

LIQUIDITY. beforeAddLiquidity admits liquidity only into the launch pool and only in the transaction that initialises it (an EIP-1153 mark set in afterInitialize): the factory's deploy, initialise and seed transaction passes, and every later transaction is refused, in the same block as well. Removing liquidity and collecting fees are never gated. Known residual, kept on purpose and pinned by a test: the mark names no account, so code that gets control later inside the opening transaction could add too; the launch factory calls only the PoolManager, the token and its own registry there. test/fork/LaunchFactory.fork.t.sol rehearses this launch through the real factory.

CONTEXT. Cocoon, FloorFeed and PupateVesting are in src/ for review and are not deployed by this launch. After it, script/PostLaunch.s.sol wires the vault to the new pool, vests the launch wallet's 5% over 12 months, pins the oracle question, and transfers Cocoon and FloorFeed to the timelock. Do not claim the code is audited or secure.

PREVIOUS ATTEMPT. Launch #1400 (base commit 697677a) passed every admission check but findings: Cocoon.skim() could run inside takeAuction's lot transfer and book the taker's unrefunded excess. This commit answers that audit; docs/REVIEW.md records each finding. (1) High, skim re-entry: fixed. skim and depositTax hold the reentrancy lock and the excess is refunded before the lot token is called; the audit's proof is a regression test (test/cocoon/CocoonReentrancy.t.sol); the Cocoon above is a new deployment of the fixed source. (2) Low, _record truncation: fixed (OutOfBounds). (3) Low, fixed-start harvest auctions: the default start is now the 100 ETH upper bound. (4) Low, burn buying nothing while the price is parked above the range: accepted; any buy resumes it. (5) Low, FloorFeed's slow recovery after a low report: accepted; FloorFeed is deployed and unchanged. PupateHook and PupateToken are byte-identical to launch #1400.
